correctness.rationale: The 1/6 cubic chord integral gives exact primal area; consecutive dual support lines give explicit polar corners and determinant yields q/D loss. Their algebraic product exchange is positive since K_A lies in the unit disk and inside the full parabolic lens (polar >= pi, primal <= 8/3, D >= 1). Hausdorff convergence justifies infinite sequences and the two sharp geometric limits. The independent exact-rational clipping checker passed 7376 assertions; proof covers real parameters.

value.rationale: The exact two-volume exchange and strict all-knot monotonicity provide a structural, quantitative refinement mechanism for an established natural convex-body family, despite Mahler product being nonmonotone under arbitrary inclusion. It solves the natural sharp range question for all finite and infinite almost-polygonal samples, and explicitly determines the two geometric endpoint approximations, without claiming the endpoint constants are new.
